solid_body = p.part

pocket = Pos(leg_length/2, leg_width/2, extrude_height - pocket_depth/2) * Box(pocket_length, pocket_width, pocket_depth)

for e in vertical_edges:

        break

csk_r = countersink_diameter / 2
csk_h = (csk_r - shaft_r) / math.tan(math.radians(countersink_angle / 2))
